title: Record a verified leader check on a capped cell
action: Create verbs/cells/leader_check.rs holding the whole obligation, the way dissent.rs holds its own (handler + record + debt + escape in one topic file — NOT handlers_meta.rs). Four parts. (1) const LEADER_CHECK_DOOR_INTRODUCED_AT: &str — today's date at 00:00:00.000Z, per D5. (2) run_leader_check(flags, use_json, t0): flags --id, --verdict (ok|gap), --file, --session-id, --force-ownership, --json — every one of those names is ALREADY in the 210-name registry vocabulary, so catalog.rs is NOT touched and PINNED_FLAG_COUNT is NOT bumped. Walk handlers_meta.rs:184-214's path: read_file_text + parse_json_js, assert_not_archived, guard_claim_ownership, merge_trace, write_cell. Payload schema leader-check/1: {schema, answers:[{requirement, artifact}]}. Refuse a bad schema, an unknown verdict, an uncapped cell, and an archived cell (name bee cells unarchive in the refusal). (3) D3a derivation, in order: must_haves.truths when non-empty; else one requirement per trace.files_changed entry; else exactly one free requirement. Refuse when answers do not cover every derived requirement, naming the misses. (4) D3 verification, the point of the whole feature: an artifact string that looks like a repo path (contains '/' and no whitespace) MUST exist on disk relative to the repo root, and at least one answer per cell MUST name a path present in that cell's trace.files_changed. Refuse, naming the offending artifact, otherwise. Append the entry {verdict, answers, recorded_at, recorded_by} to trace.leader_check (an array, append-only) — and per D8 NEVER touch cell status, not even on gap. Then: pub mod leader_check + re-exports in verbs/cells/mod.rs beside the dissent ones; the match arm "leader-check" => leader_check::run_leader_check(flags, use_json, t0) in verbs/cells/util.rs beside :88's judge-record arm; and the cells.leader-check entry in src/generated/registry_payload.json, hand-edited per decision 3358743e (no regen chain exists here).
